fixed_split.tuning_cost: Sum incurred native expenses of all six development worlds; attribute exactly once across two fixed-split evaluation setup envelopes, central receives integer residual. Do not add development expense again to the already-attributed evaluation lifecycle score. Independent simulation histories are not pooled.
